title: Compact Pulse Tiles: quickstart observability assets (latency, cost-per-token, trace preview)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact set of onboarding-ready observability screenshots and micro-assets (called "Pulse Tiles") to appear in the Quickstart docs, the Console welcome tour, and marketing one-pagers. Each Pulse Tile is a snapshot-sized visual that communicates one signal: latency distribution, cost-per-token trend, or a lightweight trace preview. Deliverables include Figma frames, export-ready PNG/JPEG at 2x and 3x, and a short usage snippet for docs that states recommended alt text and copy.
scope: Design and export 3 tile templates (Latency sparkline + histogram, Cost-per-token stacked area, Trace mini waterfall with top-level span). Provide 3 example states per tile: normal, warning (95th percentile spike or cost spike), and empty/no-data. Create hover/tooltip visual language and one-click microdrill pattern that links to full Traceboard. Provide copy and alt text for accessibility.
out_of_scope: Full Traceboard redesign, backend instrumentation changes, and localized translations (copy only in EN). Engineering implementation tickets will be separate and referenced as dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Three Pulse Tile templates exist in Figma with clear layer naming and export slices
Each template exported as PNG@2x and PNG@3x and a small SVG for docs use
Three visual states (normal/warning/empty) included for each template
Docs snippet (snippet.md) with suggested alt text and 1–2 lines of copy for the Quickstart is attached
Design handoff notes posted in ticket and PR with recommended CSS grid sizes (tile: 280x160, compact: 200x110)
Design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng (approval comments present)
assets: Example Console route to capture screenshot: /console/insights/quickstart-preview

2025-02-20 - Daniel Cho (Eng): Trace mini waterfall should not show full-span timings in the tile; instead show aggregated top-3 spans to avoid token/KV payload bloat in the render API.

notes_for_engineering: Preferred tile rendering: server-side pre-rendered PNGs for docs; client-side SVG option for interactive Console (SVG limited to sparklines only).
Suggested grid sizes: compact (200x110), standard (280x160). Provide CSS variables for border-radius and elevation to match Console tokens.
Performance note: keep asset file sizes under 40KB for 2x PNGs where possible. Use 8-bit PNG palette for sparkline-only tiles.
implementation_risks: Risk that the rendering API cannot yet return aggregated trace spans — ENG dependency may delay delivery
Potential mismatch between exported PNG colors and in-console CSS theming; include dark-mode variants to mitigate
handoff_status: Handoff package posted to Drive and Figma. Waiting on ENG-41234 to unlock interactive variant. Final exports for docs are in progress.
communication_plan: Announce in #console-design channel when exports are complete, link the Confluence quickstart page, and add a short tweet/LinkedIn-ready image to the marketing assets folder for the release notes.

Verify alt text and copy appear in Quickstart markdown
